sloka: विनष्टा जानकी व्यक्तं न ह्यदग्धः प्रदृश्यते ।लङ्कायां कश्चिदुद्देशः सर्वा भस्मीकृता पुरी ।। ५.५८.१५६ ।।।।
transliteration: vinaṣṭā jānakī vyaktaṁ na hyadagdhaḥ pradṛśyate ।laṅkāyāṁ kaściduddeśaḥ sarvā bhasmīkṛtā purī ।। 5.58.156 ।।।।

translations.english: Surely Janaki has perished, I feared, for not a spot in Lanka is seen unburnt and the whole city has been reduced to ashes.
